name: V B Desai Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, V. B. Desai Financial Services Ltd is in the business of Consultancy and Valuation[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
VBDFSL is a capital market intermediary registered with SEBI as Category I. It is engaged in Merchant Banking activities focusing on 
- ESOP valuation
- Share Valuation
- ESOP Advisory
- Merger and Acquisition
- Management of IPOs of SME and the main Stock Exchange
- Manager in Buy back of shares and in Acquisition
- Takeover of Listed Companies
- Company valuation
- Certification of AIF Placement Memorandum
- Other capital market activities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 43.2 to 32.0 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.03% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.95% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.95 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 45.8 days to 84.9 days
